text:
{
  "strengths": [
    "Strong verbal memory and excellent participation in oral discussions",
    "High proficiency in mathematics and strong spatial reasoning skills",
    "Creative and enthusiastic learner with high engagement in group activities"
  ],
  "challenges": [
    "Severe difficulty with decoding text and reading fluency causing loss of focus",
    "Persistent visual-motor letter reversals involving 'b/d' and 'p/q' in written expression",
    "High frustration levels and anxiety associated with completing reading and writing homework"
  ],
  "learning_style": "Auditory and kinesthetic learner who processes and retains complex information best through verbal discussions, listening, and hands-on spatial tasks rather than text-heavy reading.",
  "recommended_supports": [
    "Multi-sensory structured literacy approach such as Orton-Gillingham methods",
    "Provision of audiobooks, text-to-speech software, and oral examination alternatives",
    "Graphic organizers and visual templates for planning written assignments to reduce cognitive load"
  ],
  "short_term_goals": [
    "By end of Term 1, student will correctly differentiate and write letters b, d, p, and q with 85% accuracy in 4 out of 5 trials as measured by weekly spelling and writing work samples.",
    "By end of Term 2, student will read grade-level passage segments using a text-to-speech support tool and answer 80% of comprehension questions correctly in 3 consecutive assessments as measured by teacher-recorded rubrics."
  ],
  "long_term_goals": [
    "By end of academic year, student will independently decode unfamiliar grade-level words and compose structured multi-paragraph written responses using assistive speech-to-text or graphic organizers, achieving a passing grade of 70% or higher as measured by term-end academic evaluations."
  ],
  "academic_performance": {
    "overall_level": "below_grade",
    "strong_subjects": ["Mathematics"],
    "weak_subjects": ["English", "Written Expression"],
    "grade_trajectory": "stable"
  },
  "behavioural_notes": [
    "Loses focus and exhibits avoidance behaviors during independent reading tasks",
    "Displays enthusiasm, high engagement, and positive participation during collaborative group discussions"
  ],
  "assistive_tech_needs": [
    "Text-to-speech and speech-to-text software tools on digital devices"
  ]
}
